promptSummary: Original late-1990s/early-2000s Korean church leaflet and amateur Photoshop 5.5 wallpaper. Stock-photo cut and paste, enlarged blurry JPGs, crude feathered masks, duplicated clouds, mismatched scale, flat compositing. Huge white Screen-blend glow, Zoom Blur radial beams, cheap lens flares. Strong sky blue and overexposed whites. Avoid purple/pink candy colors, gold ornament, polished fantasy illustration, pixel-art texture. No text or watermark.

variants.composition: 16:9; enormous light burst at left, rows of white-robed worshippers seen from behind at lower right, oversized dove cutouts above, repeated cloud stamps.
Square; small white palace on cloud clump at lower left, huge cropped dove upper right, exaggerated radial rays, ghosted rectangular cloud photograph.
4:3; hands from bottom left and top right, cloud double exposure in hands, diagonal white burst, small tilted wings with drop shadow, mismatched cloud photos.
3:4; three overlapping tilted cloud, dove and gate photographs; huge white flare at left; blurred clouds spilling across photo edges.
